## Summary

Describe the observable change and why it is needed.

## Public contract and compatibility

- [ ] Object/state IDs, roles, types, units, write flags, and `ack` behavior were reviewed.
- [ ] Configuration, persisted formats, runtime requirements, and documented behavior were reviewed.
- [ ] Any compatibility break is labeled `BREAKING` and has an ADR and migration/rollback notes.

## Security, privacy, and licenses

- [ ] No credential, token, serial, private address/name, map, capture, or real installation data is included.
- [ ] New dependencies and source material have documented provenance and compatible licenses.

## Validation

List focused tests, `check:quick`/`check:full`, real-device evidence, and anything not verified.
